resolve_empty: ✍️ Drop me a @handle or UC… ID to look up!
resolve_network: 📡 YouTube's being quiet… Try again in 30s.
resolve_unknown: 😅 Something glitched. Is the handle right?
cmd_not_tracked: 🤔 **{handle}** isn't on the list. Run `/livestream list` to see it.
cmd_invalid: ❌ Invalid input — I need a @handle or a UC… ID.
cmd_real_alert: ✅ Real live alert sent — @{handle} is actually streaming!
cmd_test_preview: 🧪 Preview sent (marked TEST). @{handle} is **not live** — layout preview only.

errors.cooldown: Hold on — an alert just went out for this channel. Waiting before the next one.
errors.not_tracked: This channel isn't tracked anymore. Re-add it with `/livestream set`.
errors.guild_missing: I can't see this server anymore — check that I'm still in it.
errors.channel_gone: The channel I was posting to is gone. Point me to a new one with `/livestream set`.
errors.no_permission: I can't post in {channel} — I'm missing **Send Messages** or **Embed Links**. Check the channel's permissions.
errors.no_access: I can't see {channel} — my permissions got stripped. Can an admin check?
errors.invalid_emoji: Discord rejected an emoji in the card. Ping an admin, they'll check the registry.

prefix_server_only: This command works on a server only, not in DMs.
prefix_channel_not_found: ❌ Can't find that channel. Check the mention.
already_tracked: You are already tracking **{handle}** in <#{channel}>. Nothing to change!
toggle_admin_only: Only server admins can change alerts.
list_hint: Tap a button to switch alerts · admins only
card_live_body: {name} is streaming on YouTube right now.
card_preview_body: This is a layout preview, not a real alert. {name} isn't streaming right now.
list_empty: Nothing tracked yet. Add a channel with {mention}.
owner_only: Only the server owner or an admin can manage YouTube alerts.
set_hint: Switch alerts here or anytime from {mention}.
